messages.subject: Export tree in newick format
parts:
Hi all, 
I really like the package and had a question about the function "clusterSamples". The dendrogram I obtained is nice but wanted to know if there was a mean to export the topology as a newick file. Thanks!!
Jonathan

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Export tree in newick format
parts:
There clusterSamples returns the output of hclust(), than you can feed that into as.phylo() and write.tree() functions from ape package from CRAN, to write the tree in newick format. I haven't tried this myself but according to ape documentation it should work.

Best,
Altuna
